review.summary: The draft needs adjustments for accessibility, readability, and typographic consistency before it can be presented to Hale & Whitford LLP.

flags.issue: Text on the dark blue background may not meet WCAG contrast requirements, risking accessibility non‑compliance.
flags.suggestion: Lighten the text color or add a subtle overlay to ensure a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for body copy and 3:1 for large text.

flags.issue: The left panel contains dense blocks of copy, which can overwhelm readers and reduce scan‑ability.
flags.suggestion: Introduce more whitespace, increase line‑height, or break the copy into short bullet points to improve hierarchy and readability.

flags.issue: All‑caps usage for the logo and top label can hinder legibility and appear overly formal for digital media.
flags.suggestion: Switch to title case or small‑caps for the logo and label while keeping the headline in sentence case as specified.
